output.content: I need the deployment pipeline to run from the model registry straight to the serving endpoint without any manual intervention. The nightly forecast job must be fully automated so it restores itself before the promotion week starts. If we rely on a human to click deploy, the system will miss the morning order window, and every store will order blind. I want the tooling to handle the entire path automatically. More automation in the pipeline is better for reliability. I am open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but the core execution must remain automated to meet the deadline.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement expresses a need for full automation to meet a deadline and improve reliability, and the author explicitly states that more automation makes them happier, indicating a desire to exceed the minimum requirement of just having a pipeline.
